heading:
THE ENCYCLICAL EPISTLE OF THE CHURCH AT SMYRNA
CONCERNING THE MARTYRDOM OF THE HOLY POLYCARP.
paragraphs:
The church of God which sojourns at Smyrna, to
the church of God sojourning in Philomelium,[396]
and to all the congregations[397] of the holy and
catholic church in every place: Mercy, peace,
and love from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,
be multiplied.
